about.title: About me
about.subtitle: Technical versatility focused on execution and trust
about.lead: I am Victor Theodoro, a technology specialist, teacher, and founder of BYTHE.
about.bio: My career grew from hands-on work: solving computer, network, infrastructure, and system problems to keep people and businesses working. In Vale do Ribeira, I have built trust through service, referrals, and professional training.
about.bio2: I currently combine IT services, teaching technology courses, and a degree in Multiplatform Software Development at Fatec Registro. I also build projects connecting software, hardware, and social impact, such as WACS.
